name: Darden Restaurants
description: Darden owns and operates 2,202 full-service restaurants in the United States across eleven brands, led by Olive Garden (949 restaurants) and LongHorn Steakhouse (618), plus Cheddar's, Chuy's, Yard House and a fine-dining group (Ruth's Chris, The Capital Grille, Eddie V's). It earns money by selling meals and drinks in company-run restaurants, with no franchising, and keeps profit by buying food at scale from more than 1,400 suppliers. Fiscal 2026 (53 weeks, ended 2026-05-31) sales were $13.2B, up 9.4 percent, helped by an extra week and a full year of Chuy's. Olive Garden alone is 42 percent of sales and about 49 percent of the four segments' profit.
